body.text: Current live preflight confirms the exact localhost:8765/callback loopback redirect and a configured client, but no retained token exists. A fresh consent attempt just timed out, so this epoch deliberately did not overlap it. Reheat only with an operator available to approve visible Google consent; then enumerate blogs before publishing only the two hash-validated ProofBundle posts and project safe API receipts.

subject: Blogger publication remains gated on visible OAuth consent
